I don't think this game really holds up anymore. Dialogue and story heavy games from "back in da day" like Planescape: Torment can get away with being mechanically outdated because that's not why you pick them up. This game on the other hand is mostly archaic turn-based combat, that I have no doubt was considered pretty good at time of release, but now is stale at best, with a few moments of interesting dialogue and world-building in between. It's worth checking out if you're really into Fallout, but otherwise, there are probably more entertaining uses of your time.

The weapon selection is nice, but the Snipers and Shotguns are overpowered as hell. The maps are well designed, but uh, it's no secret they're completely ripped off from CS:GO with a different setting added to them. 

It's free, so you can't complain... Or can you?
